name: Currency Exchange 3
definition: Information needed to process a currency exchange or conversion.

SourceCurrency.name: Source Currency
SourceCurrency.definition: Currency of the amount to be converted in a currency conversion.

TargetCurrency.name: Target Currency
TargetCurrency.definition: Currency into which an amount is to be converted in a currency conversion.

UnitCurrency.name: Unit Currency
UnitCurrency.definition: Currency in which the rate of exchange is expressed in a currency exchange. In the example 1GBP = xxxCUR, the unit currency is GBP.

ExchangeRate.name: Exchange Rate
ExchangeRate.definition: Factor used for the conversion of an amount from one currency into another. This reflects the price at which one currency was bought with another currency.||Usage: ExchangeRate expresses the ratio between UnitCurrency and QuotedCurrency (ExchangeRate = UnitCurrency/QuotedCurrency).

ContractIdentification.name: Contract Identification
ContractIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier of the foreign exchange contract.

QuotationDate.name: Quotation Date
QuotationDate.definition: Date and time at which an exchange rate is quoted.
